_meta.description: Every tool in ARK, the app-pipeline suite: Rocket, Soren, Knox, Monkr, Levi, Tom and Hopps, and what each one does.
a-checklist-board-you.72948e: A checklist board you work through on your phone. A green board unlocks the submit button.
a-music-machine-for.03b50b: A music machine for jingles and soundtracks.
ai-writes-files-only.61e953: AI writes files; only you publish
app-store-connect-analytics.deb95d: App Store Connect analytics, sales, device mix, ratings, reviews, chart rankings and keyword positions, plus Google Play and Microsoft Store stats and reviews.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
canvas-presets-for-every.ea0aef: Canvas presets for every App Store and Google Play size, with headlines and backgrounds.
chainable-presets-turn-a.a0490c: Chainable presets turn a layout into a short video, scored by Tom if you like.
checks-placeholders-lengths-and.1baebe: Checks placeholders, lengths and glossary terms, and uses the compiler to find strings the catalog never heard of.
cloudflare-web-analytics-lined.43355c: Cloudflare web analytics lined up against store page views.
compares-two-audits-what.5a8e23: Compares two audits: what's new, what was fixed and what persists. A new critical or high finding fails the gate.
copy-localization-and-documentation.3439: Copy, localization and documentation changes ship on their own. Code changes wait for your approval.
cross-platform-qa-that.c08b14: Cross-platform QA that gates every release.
drafts-the-version-on.580b9d: Drafts the version on every platform, pushes the listing, uploads the build and frames the screenshots, then stops before submit so QA comes first.
each-finding-has-a.ac8417: Each finding has a severity, a location, an attack scenario and a specific fix, in a dated report.
every-audit-follows-the.fba2f8: Every audit follows the same fixed method, from attacker capabilities through authentication, cryptography and injection to the supply chain.
exits-non-zero-on.990e43: Exits non-zero on any failure, so a release script, an agent or a CI job stops on red.
from-green-tests-to.d446fd: From green tests to every store
keeps-leaderboards-achievements-pric.1ce: Keeps leaderboards, achievements, prices and availability in step with files in the repo.
knows-when-the-english.45b6f8: Knows when the English has moved on, so only stale or missing strings get translated.
knox-raises-the-floor.6e5242: Knox raises the floor on every release. Novel cryptography is flagged for specialist review, never certified.
monkr-asks-tom-for.a53452: Monkr asks Tom for a jingle whose final hit lands exactly where the clip needs it.
one-config-file-lives.e79156: One config file lives with each project. The tool itself knows nothing about any app.
one-metadata-file-feeds.b04343: One metadata file feeds all three stores, trimmed to each store's limits. Google Play gets tracks and staged rollouts.
one-tap-hands-a.10a599: One tap hands a ticket or suggestion to Claude Code, which drafts the change in an isolated git worktree and runs the tests.
operational-awareness-with-a.cd246d: Operational awareness, with a fix button.
pick-a-station-and.8f85cd: Pick a station and Tom keeps writing new songs in that style.
pixel-true-frames-for.091f88: Pixel-true frames for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV and more, in every color.
run-by-hand-by.689e3d: Run by hand, by an agent or in CI
runs-as-a-background.50cd5a: Runs as a background service on your Mac, reachable over Tailscale, with no tracking SDKs in any app.
runs-xcode-simulator-tests.d17adf: Runs Xcode simulator tests, Rust, Gradle unit and device tests, Node checks or any command, and sums them up on one pass/fail board.
seven-tools-one-skeleton.15174b: Seven tools, one skeleton. Each is a small command-line program with the same layout and a guided setup, so learning one is learning all of them.
ships-to-the-app.d7ee72: Ships to the App Store, Google Play and the Microsoft Store.
simplified-chinese-japanese-german.dd627: Simplified Chinese, Japanese, German, French, Spanish, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian, on every surface.
snap-intro-verse-chorus.26276f: Snap intro, verse, chorus and ending blocks together, or let Auto build the rest.
style-key-tempo-swing.652c04: Style, key, tempo, swing and shape: dial them in and Tom writes the melody.
support-emails-become-tickets.0942ae: Support emails become tickets, next to the reviews and numbers they relate to.
the-same-layout-and.9ba379: The same layout and a guided setup
the-same-renderer-runs.184639: The same renderer runs from the command line, so fresh captures become framed images without a click.
waits-until-the-newest.4d9bdf: Waits until the newest build has really finished processing, attaches it and submits it for review, and refuses anything that would stall the release.
writes-junit-and-json.422dcb: Writes JUnit and JSON results and a step summary for continuous integration.
xcode-string-catalogs-store.5353d7: Xcode String Catalogs, store listings, Android resources and web dictionaries, rewritten byte for byte.
youtube-and-product-hunt.bd9682: YouTube and Product Hunt, with Instagram and X optional.
